title: 第518章 萧国主好久不见第517章 只求度过初赛
slug: 开局逼我献祭我有天道赐福
content_zh:
第518章萧国主，好久不见~
冷千双眯了眯眼睛，想到上一届的比赛，语气有些怀念，“唉，最近这几十届来看，还得是凌绝那一届最给咱们青云道院争气。”
“那时候，他们几个亲传弟子拼了老命，拿了个第三回来，可给我们院里高兴坏了。”
“那真是这么多年来最好的成绩了，可惜五十名弟子都伤的不轻，重伤后被抬出来的有二十八个，死在那里的有五个，几位亲传各自都闭关了几年才稍稍修养回来。”
言攸宁眸光闪了闪，眉头微蹙：“还，还有师姐师兄死在那儿？”
冷千双沉默了许久，才道：“既是比赛，场内意外本就不可避免。往年也会偶尔弟子丧命，但那次的争夺战太激烈了些，其他家也有不少丧命的弟子。”
“镇灵宗也没想到举办了这么多届的比赛，会在那时出了那么多人命，也不知道这一届会不会调整比赛规则，唉……”
萧杙同言攸宁都默默低下了头，为自己素未谋面的师兄师姐默哀。
冷千双调整了下情绪，重新开口，“所以，此次大赛，我们这些老家伙也不指望你们多能干，说实在的，这么多届下来，启明洲早就默认风云大赛是给那些中小门派分发资源的比赛了。”
“你们啊，能进复赛最好，进不去也正常，别有压力，我只要你们这些人一个不落地回来，安全为上，能不受伤最好，反正只要没进决赛奖品都差不多，没必要在里面拼命。”
言攸宁同萧杙一起拱手，应道，“是，师父，弟子领命。”

另一边，温郗离开青云道院后，直奔天启天城的皇宫。
穿越各城池间的屏障时，温郗直接把她的天启皇室令牌给挂在了腰间。虽说记忆恢复了，身份也昭告天下了，但这个令牌顾千远还是让温郗留下了。
她说：“小郗，你永远都是我的孩子，天启永远是你的家，想回来就回来吧。”
顾千远都这么说了，萧青岚自然举双手双脚同意，所以温郗此刻才能在天启境内自如穿梭。
来到天启皇宫上方后，温郗一个跃身，在空中翻滚了七百二十度后直接跳进了萧青岚的宫殿院子里。
她双手张开，稳稳当当落在了那棵盛放的梧桐树下。
温郗满意地朝着空气左右各点了点头，觉得自己这一套完美的空中翻滚动作值得评委打个十分。

还没嘚瑟完，温郗转过身时就看见一堆人正站在殿内，刚刚还禁闭的殿门已经敞开，显然是刚刚才推开殿门。
他们此刻，无一例外正目瞪口呆的看着她。
他们之中有男有女，各自参半，身上穿着形制统一但颜色不同的朝服，头上还都戴着官帽。
显而易见，他们就是天启帝国的文武百官。
清风吹过，卷起片片梧桐叶。他们所有人都愣愣地看着这个从天而降的绿衣女修，眼里掺杂着震惊与压抑不住的笑意。
简言之，他们针对温郗这一连串的跳水动作，很想笑，但顾忌着天启官员的形象，正在硬憋。
于是，在这种氛围下，一股淡淡的尴尬正在院落中蔓延，且愈来愈浓。
温郗：……
苍天无眼，怎么每隔一段时间，就要她社死一回？这算是什么固定指标吗？
第518章萧国主，好久不见~
而且，这个时间点怎么会开朝会啊喂？！
早朝早朝，不都是早上开的吗？这半下午的开啥！

Chapter 518 Lord Xiao, long time no see~
Leng Qianshuang narrowed her eyes, thinking of the last competition, her tone was a bit nostalgic, "Well, judging from the past few dozen competitions, Ling Jue's competition has to be the most popular for our Qingyun Taoist Academy."
"At that time, several of their direct disciples risked their lives and came back with a third place, which made our courtyard very happy."
"That was really the best result in so many years. It's a pity that all fifty disciples were seriously injured. Twenty-eight of them were carried out after serious injuries, and five of them died there. Several direct disciples each spent several years in seclusion before recovering a little."
Yan Youning's eyes flashed and he frowned slightly: "Also, are there any senior sisters and brothers dead there?"
Leng Qianshuang was silent for a long time and then said: "Since it is a competition, accidents on the field are inevitable. In previous years, disciples would occasionally lose their lives, but the battle that time was too fierce, and many disciples from other families also lost their lives."
"The Zhenling Sect didn't expect that after so many competitions, so many lives would be lost at that time. I don't know if the rules of the competition will be adjusted this time. Alas..."
Xiao Zhu and Yan Youning both lowered their heads silently and mourned for the senior brothers and sisters they had never met.
Leng Qianshuang adjusted her mood and spoke again, "So, we old guys don't expect you to be very capable in this competition. To be honest, after so many years, Qimingzhou has long accepted that the Fengyun Competition is a competition to distribute resources to small and medium-sized sects."
"You guys, it's best if you can make it to the semi-finals. It's normal if you can't make it. Don't be stressed. I just want you guys to come back without falling. Safety is the first priority. It's best if you don't get hurt. Anyway, as long as you don't make it to the finals, the prizes will be the same. There's no need to work hard in it."
Yan Youning and Xiao Zhu raised their hands together and said, "Yes, master. Disciple accepts the order."

On the other side, after Wen Xi left Qingyun Taoist Temple, he went straight to the imperial palace in Tianqi Tiancheng.
When crossing the barriers between the cities, Wen Xi directly hung her Apocalypse royal token on her waist. Although his memory was restored and his identity was revealed to the world, Gu Qianyuan still let Wen Xi keep the token.
She said: "Xiao Xi, you will always be my child, Tianqi will always be your home, come back if you want."
Gu Qianyuan said so, and Xiao Qinglan naturally raised his hands and feet to agree, so Wen Xi could now travel freely within the territory of Tianqi.
After arriving above Tianqi Palace, Wen Xi jumped up, rolled 720 degrees in the air and jumped directly into Xiao Qinglan's palace courtyard.
She opened her hands and landed firmly under the blooming sycamore tree.
Wen Xi nodded his head to the left and right in the air with satisfaction, feeling that his perfect set of aerial tumbling actions deserved a ten-point score from the judges.
Before he finished playing, Wen Xi turned around and saw a group of people standing in the palace. The door of the palace that was closed just now was already open. It was obvious that he had just pushed the door open.
At this moment, without exception, they were staring at her in stunned silence.
There were men and women among them, half and half, wearing court uniforms of the same shape but different colors, and official hats on their heads.
Obviously, they are the civil and military officials of the Apocalypse Empire.
The breeze blew by, rolling up the sycamore leaves. All of them stared blankly at the female cultivator in green clothes who descended from the sky, their eyes filled with shock and uncontrollable smiles.
In short, they wanted to laugh at Wen Xi's series of diving moves, but they were holding back because they were concerned about the image of Tianqi officials.
Therefore, in this atmosphere, a faint embarrassment is spreading in the courtyard, and it is getting stronger and stronger.
Wen Xi:......
The sky has no eyes, so why does he want her to die every once in a while? Is this a fixed indicator?
Chapter 518 Lord Xiao, long time no see~
Moreover, why is there a court meeting at this time? !
Morning morning and morning morning, aren’t they all opened in the morning? this afternoonWhat's going on!
